title: Luke 14:1-6
subtitle: Friday of the 30th Week in Ordinary Time · Phil 1:1-11; Lk 14:1-6
text: Dining at a Pharisee's house on the sabbath, Jesus is watched closely, and before him stands a man suffering from dropsy. He heals him and sends him on his way, then asks who among them would not pull a son or an ox out of a well on the sabbath. Mercy is never out of season.
imageAlt: Engraving of Christ healing a man with dropsy as Pharisees and lawyers look on, with a feast in the background and children playing with a donkey at right
